sara: Heads up — saw a ~12% median latency regression on qwen-2.5 long-context (8k+) after the recent kernel selection change. Profiling attached. Suspect RoPE scaling + tokenizer split behavior. perf-bot: automated profile linked: https://perf.internal/runs/8972
vikram: Can you paste the flamegraph? quick suspicion: KV cache alignment issues when tokenized length differs between n_ctx and n_kv dims
sara: pasted snippet: ```trace: top func: attention_kernel_fast (gpu0) 42ms -> previously 29ms
kv_miss_ratio=0.18
rope_scale=1.0 vs model expects 0.9
tokenizer: multi-lang tokens sometimes split UTF-8 chars into 2 tokens for zh/ja
```
tom: interesting — if RoPE scaling is slightly off, ALiBi fallback could explain longer token loops. Are we running kernel chooser that picks matmul16/32 variant based on seq len?
vikram: yes chooser picks kernel_v2 if avg_seq>1024; kernel_v2 changed to use fused_qk with precompute of cos/sin scaled by model.rope_scale. If rope_scale different than runtime assumption, cos/sin index mismatch -> incorrect KV alignment (not logically wrong but causes extra cache misses because kv lookup offsets changed) :thinking: 
sara: repro steps: run batch of mixed-lang prompts (en+zh), seq length 2800, batch=6 -> p50 latency +12% p95 +9% compare to previous build
perf-bot: quick diff: kernel_v2 increases global memory loads by 9% for long seqs, extra unaligned reads around KV row boundaries
tom: short term mitigation: force kernel_v1 for seq>2048, adjust batching heuristic to prefer more uniform seq lengths, and add a tokenizer normalization step to coalesce combining marks for CJK languages
vikram: config proposal: ```runtime.kernel.prefer_v1_threshold=2048
runtime.rope.scale_override_map={"qwen-2.5":0.9}
runtime.tokenizer.normalize_combining=true
```
sara: agree. Can we also add a regression test that pumps multi-ling tokenization + long context to CI perf job? owner: @vikram for kernel change, @tom for tokenizer fix. I'll open PRs and schedule a canary
tom: I'll add a small micro-benchmark and SHARD config to the perf dashboard. :thumbsup:
vikram: noting potential longer-term: support ALiBi-compatible kernel path that avoids explicit RoPE precompute and uses relative position caching — could help multi-ling edgecases
sara: thanks. filing incident ticket and flagging on next eng-runtime standup. cc @ana for rollout timetable
ana: noted, will coordinate canary window and alert rules.
